第一站 · 游客中心与自然展览: Stop 1 · Visitor center and natural history exhibits
开放时先看 Ohlone 生活与湿地生态展览，再拿地图询问当天适合的短路段。可以: When open, begin with Ohlone life and wetland ecology exhibits, collect a map, and ask which short sections suit the day. Let children choose a bird or plant to look for. If the center is closed, read outdoor interpretation and keep your starting point near the parking area rather than switching to an unfamiliar entrance.
按现场指示走到当天开放的木栈道或湿地边缘，停下来观察水面与芦苇间的动静。用望远镜: Follow signs to the boardwalk or marsh-edge area open that day and pause to watch the water and reeds. Binoculars bring wildlife closer without chasing it. Keep children on designated surfaces, do not feed wildlife or collect plants, and use an open marsh-edge viewpoint if the boardwalk is closed.
第三站 · Bayview Trail 短段折返: Stop 3 · A short Bayview Trail out-and-back
回到适合接入的路口，按地图选一段 Bayview 铺装路慢走，看看湿地与草坡如何: Return to a suitable junction and choose a section of the paved Bayview Trail on the map, observing where wetland meets grassland. The full official loop is longer than this starter walk. Set a turnaround time, and return along your route if gradients, headwinds, or tired children become a concern, saving energy for the walk back to parking.
铺装不等于平坦，阴凉与返程都要预留: Paved does not mean flat: allow for shade and the return
游客中心区域有无障碍停车与洗手间，但山坡和所有支线不能因此视为轮椅适用；带推车先: The visitor center area has accessible parking and restrooms, but that does not make every hillside or side trail wheelchair-friendly; stroller users should ask about surfaces and grades. Bring enough water, a hat, sunscreen, and a layer for wind. After rain, follow signs around flooding and mud. Transit users need a separate station-to-park connection; a nearby BART station is not a trailhead. Leave a buffer for parking gate closure and ride pickup.
